thumbnail.alt: Three dot grids, one dot per request to Drupal, one column per page of a 24-page warm crawl. Druxt 0.24.0 makes 17 on most pages and 29 and 35 on the two section pages, 438 in all. Druxt 0.25.0 with cache.content off makes 11 on most pages, 294 in all. Druxt 0.25.0 with cache.content on makes none on any page. Counted at a proxy in front of Drupal answering max-age 300.
